ARCHIVE_ASANA: Asana: https://<client id>:<client secret>@app.asana.com, ?push=1 once the app has the webhooks scopes. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_BREX: Brex: https://<client id>:<client secret>@accounts-api.brex.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_CLICKUP: ClickUp: https://<client id>:<client secret>@app.clickup.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_COINBASE: Coinbase: https://<client id>:<client secret>@login.coinbase.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_DENTRIX: Dentrix: https://<server key>@nexhealth.info. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_DROPBOX: Dropbox: https://<client id>:<client secret>@www.dropbox.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_GITHUB_APP: GitHub: https://<client id>:<client secret>@github.com, ?hook=<webhook secret>. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_GOOGLE: Google Calendar, Google Drive and Gmail: https://<client id>:<client secret>@accounts.google.com, which sign-in with Google reads too. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_HUBSPOT: HubSpot: https://<client id>:<client secret>@app.hubspot.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_KLAVIYO: Klaviyo: https://<client id>:<client secret>@www.klaviyo.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_MAILCHIMP: Mailchimp: https://<client id>:<client secret>@login.mailchimp.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_NEST: Google Nest: https://<client id>:<client secret>@nestservices.google.com, ?project=<Device Access project ID>; the OAuth client is a Google Cloud web client the Device Access project names. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_NETSUITE: NetSuite: https://<client id>:<client secret>@system.netsuite.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_OPENDENTAL: Open Dental: https://<server key>@api.opendental.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_OUTLOOK: Business Central, Business Central sandbox, Outlook, SharePoint and Microsoft Teams: https://<client id>:<client secret>@login.microsoftonline.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_PLAID: Plaid: https://<server key>@production.plaid.com, <client id>:<secret> as its server key, or @sandbox.plaid.com with the Sandbox secret. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_QUICKBOOKS: QuickBooks: https://<client id>:<client secret>@appcenter.intuit.com, ?sandbox=1 for development keys, &hook=<webhooks verifier token> for its pushes. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_RAMP: Ramp: https://<client id>:<client secret>@app.ramp.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_SALESFORCE: Salesforce: https://<client id>:<client secret>@login.salesforce.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_SHOPIFY: Shopify: https://<client id>:<client secret>@admin.shopify.com, ?all_orders=1 asks for read_all_orders too, for orders over 60 days old, once Shopify has approved the app for it. The app's configuration subscribes app/uninstalled and the privacy topics customers/data_request, customers/redact and shop/redact to <API>/push/shopify. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_TESLA: Tesla: https://<client id>:<client secret>@auth.tesla.com, Tesla's Fleet API in North America and Asia-Pacific; the app's allowed origin and redirect URI are Archive's, and its partner account is registered with the public key at /.well-known/appspecific/com.tesla.3p.public-key.pem on that origin. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_YNAB: YNAB: https://<client id>:<client secret>@app.ynab.com. A space leaves it off.
ARCHIVE_ZOHO: Zoho Books and Zoho CRM: https://<client id>:<client secret>@accounts.zoho.com. A space leaves it off.
